strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal cross-platform VPN whose logical weak-network behavior approaches UDP/QUIC while public carriers remain stock REALITY/Vision over real kernel TCP.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: M10-003B real low-loss two-lane fault-path qualification
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not tune RBC/FEC policy, freeze a production FEC frame, modify REALITY/Vision, or start TUN/platform integration until the real normal-network gate remains green and the real userspace fault path passes a staged progression: approximately 50 ms RTT/~1% impairment, then 80-150 ms/~2%, before 150-300 ms/10-20%, correlated burst loss, and 250-600 ms/~30%. Keep the 2.0x intentional-redundancy ceiling.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed M10-003A at substantive HEAD 3c975ae47fe3a87f226282721c161e294ff423f1: added a real localhost bidirectional RTT calibration gate using kernel TCP/UDP sockets and the same seeded 20-30 ms one-way schedule for native TCP, native UDP, WBD normal and WBD Auto. WBD uses real frame encoding, lane.TCP, and server-side session.Receiver.AcceptData; application delivery is not gated on logical ACK, FEC, duplication or rescue. A 64-sample concurrent local run had target mean RTT 49.445669 ms; inlier means were native TCP 51.078 ms, native UDP 51.108 ms, WBD normal 51.104 ms and WBD Auto 50.989 ms. WBD normal median excess was 1.444 ms versus native TCP 1.354 ms, and Auto remained at 1.0x. Raw tail metrics retain explicitly reported shared-host descheduling outliers. The local sandbox passed vet, normal/race tests, protocol fuzz (~138,710 executions), Linux/386, Linux/mipsle and Windows/amd64 benchmark cross-builds, wbd-rtt Linux/mipsle and Windows/amd64 cross-builds, handoff verification and continuity tests. The normal RTT report SHA-256 is 818a6b807772d1097cbc511b9971a14e9cfe1da816ed080e199d71058d85e6ca.
